szoveg_eredeti:
We’re sharing a new preprint showing wet lab validation of intrinsic protein design capabilities of the GPT-6 family of models. Our models can design new protein shapes and sequences using reasoning and code, without calling specialized biology models to generate them.

In lab tests with Onava , proteins based on GPT‑6.2’s designs showed evidence of binding, or attachment, across five targets. Redesigned antibodies also retained binding. Specialized models helped supply sequences and select candidates for testing.

This is a proof of concept. Next, we want to test whether these proteins do something useful after attaching, tackle harder targets, and extend the work to other types of molecules.

Our goal is for scientists to one day design working medicines simply by prompting. We want to accelerate both the protein design cycle and reduce the number of experiments needed to find a functional protein.
